content.text: Monitoring: None: drug levels are predictable
PAD: 2.5mg BID + ASA 81 (dual-pathway inhib; only DOAC w FDA-approved PAD indication)
MOA: direct, selective, reversible inhib of free + clot-bound Xa -> ⇣PLT activate + fibrin clot form
Boxed warning: premature d/c of any PO anticoag ⇡thrombotic events - if stopped for a reason other than pathological bleed or completion of tx, cover w another anticoag; spinal/epidural hematoma
: bind directly to Xa, preventing conversion of prothrombin to thrombin, ending the rest of the coag cascade → prevents clot form
Specific direct thrombin inhibitor therapy for short-term anticoag (until PLT count returns to norm & warfarin can be started)
